title: Spicy Korean Black Pudding Namul
description: A fusion of Indian and Korean flavors, this spicy namul is made with crispy black pudding and a variety of adventurous vegetables.

ingredients.name: Namul (Adventurous Greens)
ingredients.notes: such as gai lan or bok choy

instructions: 1. Cut the black pudding into small pieces and pan-fry until crispy.
2. In a separate pan, heat some oil and sauté the namul greens until wilted.
3. In a large bowl, combine the crispy black pudding, wilted namul, and a drizzle of lime juice.
4. Sprinkle the smoky garam masala and Korean chili flakes over the top.
5. Season with salt to taste and garnish with chopped cilantro.
6. Serve immediately as a spicy snack.
